args.intro: If you love Tems' soulful vocals, deep grooves, and laid-back alté vibe, this selection will be right up your alley.
args.closing: Press play, unwind, and let these sweet vibrations carry you away.

picks.why: Tems delivers her signature dreamy, introspective magic here, pairing mid-tempo percussion with mesmerizing vocal soul.
Burna Boy channels pure mellow warmth on this afro-fusion classic, boasting a laid-back tempo and infectious smooth bounce.
Straight from the Nigerian alté movement alongside Tems, BOJ serves up relaxed grooves and distinct vocal character with a breezy rhythm.
Fireboy DML delivers effortlessly smooth melodies and sweet, airy afro-fusion rhythms that match Tems' chill sensibility.
Featuring Tems herself alongside Wizkid, this iconic mid-tempo anthem showcases her silky vocals over a lush, romantic afro-caribbean groove.
